clue.text: Delicately textured spine twisted in jest

indicators.note: in places the jumbled spine letters within the word for jest

parts.note: a jest is a bit of fun

indicators.note: twisted tells us the letters of spine are wrung into a new order

explanation.surface: A joker contorts their back while fooling around.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'spine twisted' as an injury, but 'twisted' rearranges the word to INESP, and 'in' sets that within the synonym for jest; the hyphen in the answer is ignored in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: Finespun cloth is woven from extremely thin thread, so it feels delicate.

clue.text: Last month's golden interior design

parts.note: December is the last month of the year, abbreviated Dec
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: December's gilded touches brighten a home's furnishings.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is the heraldic term for gold, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Décor is the furnishing and decoration style of a room.

clue.text: Half-surprised by district of Birmingham

indicators.note: Half signals keeping only the front five of the ten letters of the synonym for surprised

parts.note: surprised means astonished

explanation.surface: Someone is mildly taken aback by a part of a Midlands city.
explanation.walkthrough: Take the first half of ASTONISHED. ASTON is an inner district of Birmingham, England's second city, home of Aston Villa football club.
explanation.definitionFit: Aston is a named inner-city area in the north of Birmingham.

clue.text: Drink about the maximum? Say that louder!

indicators.note: about means the drink word goes round the maximum

parts.note: to sup is to drink
the peak is the maximum point

explanation.surface: Someone half-deaf asks a drinker to repeat a remark about the limit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an exhortation to raise the voice so a remark can be heard.

clue.text: Wooden shoe left in machinery part

indicators.note: in places the letter for left inside the machine part

parts.note: a cog is a toothed wheel in machinery

explanation.surface: A clog has been abandoned among the gears of a machine.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface nods to sabotage, said to come from clogs thrown into machines.
explanation.definitionFit: A clog is a traditional shoe carved from a block of timber.

clue.text: Give your views on a circular tree

parts.note: O is a circular letter
a pine is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: Someone offers an opinion about a ring-shaped tree.
explanation.definitionFit: To opine is to state an opinion.

clue.text: Inexpensively rebuilt Cenotaph, eh?

indicators.note: rebuilt says the letters of the memorial and the exclamation are put together again differently

explanation.surface: A war memorial was reconstructed on a shoestring budget, someone wonders.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something on a tight budget, spending as little as possible, is the idiom's meaning.

clue.text: Flexible in press-up, pleased

indicators.note: in tells us the answer sits within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A gymnast is limber during a press-up and happy about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Supple means bending easily, synonym of lithe.

clue.text: Pay mute earner badly

indicators.note: badly suggests the letters of the two words are arranged wrongly

explanation.surface: A silent wage-earner is poorly paid.
explanation.definitionFit: To remunerate someone is to give them money for work, a formal synonym.

clue.text: Lot more confused by the musical effect

indicators.note: confused tells us the letters of the opening words are mixed up

explanation.surface: Listeners are much more bewildered by a piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A tremolo is a rapid repetition or wavering of a note in music.

clue.text: Aquatic organisms put silver back in drink

indicators.note: in places the turned silver inside the drink

parts.note: ale is a drink

indicators.note: back tells us the symbol for silver is written right to left

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Pond life dropped a coin back into a pint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put' is only a link. Silver's chemical symbol is turned by 'back' to GA, and 'in' slips that into the drink, a convention solvers soon learn.
explanation.definitionFit: Algae are simple plant-like organisms living in water, such as seaweed.

clue.text: Notice eastern enemy agent

parts.note: a spy works for an enemy

explanation.surface: Someone spots a spy from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: To espy is to catch sight of something, synonym of spot.

clue.text: Some superfluous complaint

indicators.note: Some says only a part of the next word is wanted

explanation.surface: A grumble that is not needed at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Complaint here means an illness, and influenza is one.

clue.text: Office desk

definitions.meaning: a government department or agency office

explanation.definitionFit: Both meanings share the French origin: a writing desk, then the department working at desks.

clue.text: Item of clothing found in club raid

indicators.note: found in means the answer is sitting within the following words

explanation.surface: Police discover a garment when they raid a nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra is an undergarment worn to support the breasts.

clue.text: Wicked person, cruelly reviled, admitting nothing

indicators.note: admitting means the jumbled letters let the zero in
cruelly tells us the letters of reviled are treated roughly into a new order

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A villain is harshly condemned yet confesses to no crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cruelly' makes EVILDER from REVILED, and 'admitting' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An evildoer is a sinner or villain who commits wrongs.

clue.text: Noisily drink with slight pressure

parts.note: a slight is an insult, as is a slur
P is the physics abbreviation for pressure

explanation.surface: Someone gulps a drink loudly while under a little pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To slurp is to take liquid in with a loud sucking sound.

clue.text: They use rocking to get to sleep

indicators.note: rocking suggests the letters of the first two words are shaken about

explanation.surface: Parents rock a cradle to send a baby off.
explanation.definitionFit: Shut-eye is informal slang for a nap or slumber.

clue.text: Coach on shuttle round Asian island

indicators.note: round says the words go round the answer, holding it within them

explanation.surface: A coach on a shuttle service circles an island in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: Honshu is the largest island of Japan.
explanation.definitionFit: Honshu is Japan's main island, home to Tokyo.

clue.text: Nice French cottage, yet ignore backward interior

indicators.note: backward means that inner run is read right to left
interior says the letters wanted lie inside the two words

explanation.surface: Someone is told to overlook the back rooms of a pleasant holiday home in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interior' takes ETIG from inside 'yet ignore' and 'backward' turns it. 'Nice' looks like plain praise but is the French city.
explanation.definitionFit: A gîte is a furnished holiday home in rural France, so one in Nice qualifies.

clue.text: Amazed at a page turner

indicators.note: a page turner rearranges the two words into a new order

explanation.surface: A reader is astonished by a gripping book.
explanation.definitionFit: Agape means open-mouthed with wonder, synonym of astonished.

clue.text: Clever, but without leader, a bit wet

indicators.note: without leader says the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: brainy means clever

explanation.surface: Someone is smart but rather feeble without a guiding figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a bit wet' looks like British slang for feeble, but here it describes the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainy weather is showery, leaving things damp.

clue.text: Distribute very much, as discussed

indicators.note: as discussed suggests the words are talked about, so said out loud

parts.note: very much is a lot

explanation.surface: Someone hands out plenty, as agreed earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: To allot is to share out or assign portions.

clue.text: Reportedly steal instrument

indicators.note: Reportedly signals that the word is heard, as in a spoken report

parts.note: to loot is to steal

explanation.surface: A thief is said to have taken a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A lute is a plucked stringed instrument with a pear-shaped body.

clue.text: Relative reaches Pennsylvania after August

indicators.note: after puts the state abbreviation behind the word for august

parts.note: august means grand or stately
PA is the postal abbreviation for Pennsylvania

explanation.surface: A family member travels to Pennsylvania at the end of summer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'August' looks like the month, but it is the adjective meaning majestic.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandfather is a family member two generations up.

clue.text: Keep afloat, but don't turn in

definitions.meaning: to remain floating on the water
to not go to bed, turn in meaning retire for the night

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both remaining buoyant and staying out of bed late.

clue.text: Female relative takes egghead into pleasant surroundings

indicators.note: into places the head of egg within the word for pleasant, which surrounds it

parts.note: pleasant means nice
the head of egg is its first letter

explanation.surface: A female relative brings an intellectual into an agreeable setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' looks like an intellectual, but it means the first letter of 'egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is the daughter of one's sibling.
